outcome: need for neonatal intensive care unit admission
development of seizures in the first 72 hours of life
cohort: The study included 289 neonates delivered at the Menoufia University Hospital.
finding: The Neonatal Resuscitation and Adaptation Score (NRAS) is superior to conventional and combined Apgar scores in predicting neonatal morbidity and mortality, with a depressed 5-minute NRAS being more predictive of mortality than the 1-minute score.
